authorization.scope: Complete only V2 Milestone 5 by freezing the eligible shortlist and exact one-time calendar-2025 gates without opening holdout values.
authorization.verbatim: ok, if everything looks great lets go to milestone 5

data_lineage.development_feature_source: Validated V2 M3 point-in-time feature ledger
data_lineage.holdout_feature_availability_rule: A one-minute ZN bar becomes available at interval start plus one minute; every bar used by the four-hour change must be available no later than the 08:00 Europe/London decision.
data_lineage.holdout_feature_normalization: Licensed continuous one-minute series with explicit underlying-contract and roll-boundary lineage.

epistemic_chain.rule_explanation: A positive ZN futures-price change normally corresponds to lower nominal Treasury yields and is mapped to gold support; a negative change is mapped to gold pressure. The mapping is an inference, not observed institutional intent.

candidates.highest_risk_assumption: The recent four-hour direction of a correctly roll-normalized ZN continuous futures series continues to carry causal or reliably persistent information about the subsequent London gold session, rather than reflecting development-period selection, shared trend, or a continuous-contract construction artifact.

holdout_controls.comparison_population: Exactly the same calendar-2025 cases on which the candidate produces LONG or SHORT.
holdout_controls.selection: Use the control with the larger mean net return after the same frozen 1.0x costs.

invalidation_evidence: Any point-in-time, timestamp, DST, record-hash, provider, or roll-lineage failure.
Failure of either POSITIVE-to-LONG or NEGATIVE-to-SHORT to retain a positive mean after frozen costs.
Failure to beat the better matched always-long or always-short control.
A non-positive mean in either frozen chronological half.
A non-positive aggregate mean, profit factor at or below one, non-positive cluster-bootstrap lower bound, or q-value above 0.10.
A non-positive mean or profit factor at or below one under 1.5x frozen costs.

calendar_halves.assignment: Within London, sort every timestamp-complete calendar-2025 session case by decision_at and case_id before removing NO_BIAS cases. The first floor(N/2) cases are EARLY and the remainder are LATE.

cost_stress.stressed_formula: direction-adjusted gross XAUUSD move per ounce - 1.5 * (observed spread + frozen slippage + frozen commission)

evaluation_gates.pass_condition: Every XAUUSD execution bar and ZN feature input satisfies sealed hashes, provider identity, IANA DST, decision availability, continuous-roll lineage, and calendar boundaries with zero unresolved issue.
At least 180 calendar-2025 London cases produce LONG or SHORT.
At least 80 POSITIVE-to-LONG cases and at least 80 NEGATIVE-to-SHORT cases.
Each directional state spans at least 35 distinct ISO-week clusters.
Candidate mean net return after frozen 1.0x costs is strictly above zero.
Candidate profit factor after frozen 1.0x costs is strictly above one.
Candidate mean net return is strictly above the larger mean of ALWAYS_LONG and ALWAYS_SHORT on exactly the same directional cases and costs.
POSITIVE-to-LONG and NEGATIVE-to-SHORT cells each have mean net return strictly above zero after frozen costs.
EARLY and LATE halves each contain at least 70 directional cases and each has mean net return strictly above zero.
At 1.5x frozen costs, aggregate mean net P&L remains strictly above zero and profit factor remains strictly above one.
The ISO-week cluster-bootstrap lower 95% bound for mean net return is strictly above zero.
The one-candidate cluster sign-flip Benjamini-Hochberg q-value is at or below 0.10.

multiplicity.family: All frozen V2 shortlist candidates; exactly one candidate.

readiness_gates_before_value_access.pass_condition: At least 95% of calendar-2025 London weekdays are timestamp-complete for the frozen XAUUSD decision, entry, and exit clocks, with observed spread and no synthetic bars.
Licensed Databento GLBX.MDP3 ZN.v.0 one-minute calendar-2025 source is present, immutable, hashed, and covers the full requested interval.
Normalization records source record identifiers, underlying contracts, roll boundaries, availability timestamps, duplicate policy, and marks roll-crossing changes unavailable.
Without deserializing price values, at least 95% of timestamp-complete XAUUSD London cases have the timestamps required for a four-hour ZN change at the 08:00 decision.
All source hashes, metadata counts, timestamp ordering, provider identities, and synthetic flags pass; no 2025 OHLC value, feature value, direction, return, P&L, or chart has been inspected.

readiness_policy.blocked_action: Stop before holdout value access. Do not approximate, proxy, repair, or replace the candidate.

cluster_bootstrap.confidence_interval: Type-7 2.5 and 97.5 percent quantiles of bootstrapped mean net return.
cluster_bootstrap.seed: First eight bytes of SHA-256(M6 manifest hash | candidate code | BOOTSTRAP)

cluster_sign_flip.alternative: Mean selected return is greater than zero.
cluster_sign_flip.seed: First eight bytes of SHA-256(M6 manifest hash | candidate code | SIGN_FLIP)

holdout_source_readiness.required_action: Acquire licensed Databento GLBX.MDP3 ZN.v.0 one-minute calendar-2025 history, normalize with roll-aware lineage, hash and seal it, then complete a metadata-only candidate-specific audit before any value or outcome access.
